0022600204.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-7, 2-4 at home) are on a six-game losing streak and sit 10th in the East, while the Cleveland Cavaliers (5-5, 1-3 on the road) come in 7th after a loss in their last game. Ruled out for Charlotte are Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), while Brandon Miller (groin soreness) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are day-to-day and game-time decisions; for Cleveland, Jaylon Tyson is out with an ankle sprain, and Jarrett Allen (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hornets lost their 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 118-113 loss in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
